tca.aconitase.text_dramatic: TBD — aconitase flips cis-aconitate 180 degrees; your two carbons are distinguished.
tca.aconitase.text_teaching: TBD — Phase 7 teaching text citing the approved prochirality claim (the Ogston hypothesis). NOTE: human mitochondrial ACO2 (UniProt Q99798) has NO PDB structure (verified via UniProt REST, 0 cross-refs). Bovine mitochondrial aconitase 1ACO (2.05 A, the classic Ogston-hypothesis teaching structure) is a candidate for Phase 7 approval. Using pdb:TBD_ACONITASE placeholder until a structure is approved.

tca.co2_turn1.text_dramatic: TBD — one of your carbons leaves as a breath of CO2 on the first turn.

tca.co2_turn2.text_dramatic: TBD — your other carbon leaves on the second turn.

tca.isocitrate_dh.text_dramatic: TBD — isocitrate dehydrogenase strikes: isocitrate becomes alpha-ketoglutarate, and your first carbon flies off as CO2. This is the rate-limiting step of the TCA cycle.
tca.isocitrate_dh.text_teaching: TBD — Phase 7 teaching text: isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH3A, NAD+-dependent) oxidizes isocitrate to alpha-ketoglutarate, releasing the FIRST CO2 of the TCA cycle and producing NADH. Rate-limiting, regulatory step. PDB 5GRF is a CANDIDATE structure (IDH3A) pending Phase 7 approval.

choices.label: Examine the isocitrate dehydrogenase active site

tca.akg_dh.text_dramatic: TBD — alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase strikes next: alpha-KG becomes succinyl-CoA, and your second carbon leaves as CO2. The cycle has now shed both acetyl carbons.
tca.akg_dh.text_teaching: TBD — Phase 7 teaching text: alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase (alpha-KGDH) oxidizes alpha-KG to succinyl-CoA, releasing the SECOND CO2 of the TCA cycle and producing NADH. Mechanistically homologous to PDH (same 3-subunit E1-E2-E3 architecture, same TPP/lipoamide/FAD cofactors). NO PDB LOAD: narrative-only node per Decision 2 (alpha-KG DH = narrative-only, no PDB).

tca.succinyl_coa_synthetase.text_dramatic: TBD — succinyl-CoA synthetase harvests the thioester bond: succinyl-CoA becomes succinate, and a substrate-level phosphorylation makes GTP. The only TCA step that makes ATP-equivalent directly.
tca.succinyl_coa_synthetase.text_teaching: TBD — Phase 7 teaching text: succinyl-CoA synthetase (SCS) converts succinyl-CoA to succinate, coupling the thioester-bond hydrolysis to GDP -> GTP phosphorylation (the ONLY substrate-level phosphorylation in the TCA cycle). NO PDB LOAD: narrative-only node.

choices.label: Examine the succinyl-CoA synthetase active site

tca.fumarase.text_dramatic: TBD — fumarase hydrates fumarate to malate, adding water across the double bond. Your carbon skeleton keeps turning.
tca.fumarase.text_teaching: TBD — Phase 7 teaching text: fumarase (fumarate hydratase) reversibly hydrates fumarate to L-malate (stereospecific). NO PDB LOAD: narrative-only node.

tca.malate_dh.text_dramatic: TBD — malate dehydrogenase oxidizes malate back to oxaloacetate, regenerating the cycle's acceptor and producing one more NADH. The wheel is whole again.
tca.malate_dh.text_teaching: TBD — Phase 7 teaching text: malate dehydrogenase oxidizes L-malate to oxaloacetate (OAA), regenerating the OAA that condenses with the next acetyl-CoA to start the cycle anew, and producing the third NADH of one TCA turn. NO PDB LOAD: narrative-only node.
